scope.cost: Seven-stage experiment timing excludes separately reported four-update recovery qualification, scheduler queue wait and outer allocation setup/teardown. Allocation costs are not recomputed here.
scope.development: Selection-exposed 584-row, 12-group data; supplemental post-selection analysis, not untouched confirmation.
scope.frozen_reference: One fixed zero-B frozen reference per precision, shared across trained seeds; not three independent frozen repetitions.
scope.memory: Historical incomplete host evidence and all negative flags remain unchanged. Sampled peaks are lower bounds; RSS/PSS excludes unmapped filesystem page cache. No physical 24GB-hardware or best-fit qualification claim.
scope.performance: Scientific comparison is selected_fixed_execution; controlled is only the unchanged public matched-settings math branch. Seed42 is reused original-v5 and seeds17/123 are fresh fixed-quality-v1.
scope.publication: Projection of completed validated analyses only; no new bootstrap, threshold, selection, scoring authority, or release decision.
scope.recovery: Only explicit committed update2 to exact updates3/4 and fresh DCP/portable reload are qualified; no claim of recovery at update300.
scope.regression: Previously exposed 256-row regression data; final diagnostic scoring does not make it untouched.
scope.training_shapes: Configured max_length4096 and8 temporal slots do not prove long-context training or8 unique source frames. This run has no complete actual training-shape telemetry.
scope.untouched_diagnostic: 32 rows from one connected recording group; both group-based intervals are nonestimable. No release qualification follows.
